description: Find schools, nurseries and childcare providers in England by name, optionally narrowed by town, county or postcode (not council or borough names: for "near Lambeth" use search_near_postcode). Returns up to 10 matches with their Catchmently IDs for get_school.

area.description: Optional town, county or postcode (full or district, e.g. SW19) to narrow the matches.

name.description: Part of the school or nursery name, e.g. "St Mary's".

name: find_school
title: Find a school by name
